portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Wide monthly relative-return spreads coexist with weak breadth, expanding business activity and an inflationary oil shock. Selective reversals are more credible than a broad rebound, while oil has independent supply-side support but substantial unwind risk. High yields and the September FOMC constrain speculative growth exposures. The dispersion judgment uses observed cross-sectional spreads because the aggregate dispersion field is blank; five-session returns are distinguished from monthly active returns.
